## Episode Thesis

DI news segment where tech reporter Henrik Ek goes through Apple's annual launch event, including its first foldable iPhone (the 'iPhone Duo', a passbook-format phone), the iPhone 18 Pro, a new Apple Watch and AirPods 5. He doubts the foldable will add much to sales, calling its price of about 27,000–44,000 SEK 'crazy', but says Apple is doing very well: the iPhone 17 Pro was its best-selling iPhone ever and the stock is close to an all-time high. The segment also mentions ChatGPT 6 Astra and the AGI debate, plus sponsor reads from Société Générale and Sats.
